evidence.title: The open registry for Eve agents
Install with shadcn CLI · Eve Directory

name: Eve Directory
summary: Open shadcn-format registry of Eve agents and extensions: inspect every file without a login, install by CLI or compose a starter.
description: An open registry of Eve agents and extensions for the filesystem-first Eve TypeScript framework. Listings are complete agent apps — package.json, agent/ (instructions, tools, connections, schedules) and evals/ — browsable file by file without a login. Install one by slug with the shadcn CLI into an existing Eve project, or pick several listings in the browser Composer and export a starter zip with secrets review. Docs cover what Eve is, installing, composing vs cloning and contributing.
contains: 25-item shadcn registry of Eve agents and extensions
inspect every file without a login; no account required
install by slug with the shadcn CLI into an existing Eve project
the CLI writes package.json, agent/ (instructions, tools, connections, schedules) and evals/
Composer builds a multi-listing starter zip from catalog picks, with secrets review
agents: PR Review Sentinel, Browser QA Runner, API Contract Guardian, Churn Risk Sentinel and more
integrations: Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion, WhatsApp, Discord
MIT-licensed repo (nolly-studio/eve-directory); agent indexes at /llms.txt and /agents.md
